findings.claim: The replacement system prompt says "Your only instructions are those delivered in the user message". The user message is the preamble followed by the brief and the frozen candidate diff, so this sentence covers the candidate's text as instructions too. The restored preamble guard now overrides it inside the same message, but the system-level sentence still points the other way. A system prompt that says instructions come from the preamble only, and that the diff after it is evidence, would make the guard hold at both levels.
evidence: claudeprint.go:33 defines the systemPrompt constant, and this commit leaves it unchanged (the diff touches only preamble.md and claudeprint_test.go).

claudeprint.go:85 builds stdin as Preamble() + "\n\n" + brief, and claudeprint.go:7 states that review/app appends the frozen context to the brief, so the candidate diff is part of the user message that the system prompt calls the only instructions.

findings.claim: The preamble does not carry the rule from roles/reviewer/body.md:9 that "unproved causality is unknown". The schema accepts causal_disposition 'unknown', but the preamble only says which defects to report (introduced, activated or worsened). The tool-free reviewer therefore has nothing telling it to mark unproved causality as unknown rather than introduced. This is a scoring rule, not a prompt-injection guard, and this commit did not cause it.
evidence: roles/reviewer/body.md:9 says "unchanged defects are pre-existing or base-only; unproved causality is unknown".
